queries: WITH station_counts AS (SELECT o.observstation, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count FROM observatories AS o LEFT JOIN telescopes AS t ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation), station_shares AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, CAST(telescope_count AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(telescope_count) OVER (), 0) AS share FROM station_counts), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM station_shares) SELECT s.observstation, s.telescope_count, s.share, s.share - a.value AS share_minus_average FROM station_shares AS s CROSS JOIN average_share AS a WHERE s.share > a.value ORDER BY share_minus_average DESC, s.observstation LIMIT 10;

WITH station_counts AS (SELECT o.observstation, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count FROM observatories AS o LEFT JOIN telescopes AS t ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation), shares AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, 1.0 * telescope_count / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes), 0) AS share FROM station_counts), compared AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, share - average_share AS share_above_average FROM compared WHERE share > average_share ORDER BY share_above_average DESC, observstation LIMIT 10;

WITH station_counts AS (SELECT o.observstation, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count FROM observatories AS o LEFT JOIN telescopes AS t ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation), shares AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, 1.0 * telescope_count / NULLIF(SUM(telescope_count) OVER (), 0) AS share FROM station_counts), ranked AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_minus_average FROM shares) SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, share_minus_average FROM ranked WHERE share_minus_average > 0 ORDER BY share_minus_average DESC, observstation LIMIT 10;
